dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The lateral flank displays multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, high-contrast dark perimeters that exhibit a sharp gradient transition into lighter interior centers; geometry varies from circular to vertically elongated ovals.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A low spatial density of high-intensity white pixel clusters is localized along the ventral boundary, while solid low-intensity dark patches lacking internal gradients are interspersed between the macro-annuli in the dorsal-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-section form a right-angled triangular configuration, with the vertical distance between the top two rings being approximately equal to the horizontal distance to the adjacent left-most 'C' shaped structure.
